headline: Tobacco product sales permit suspension hearings for two sales to a minor, plus monthly health reports.
summary: The meeting includes hearings on tobacco product sales permit suspensions for two sales to a minor. Reports cover tobacco control, development services inspections, PrideStar EMS, and several health division updates.
items: Tobacco product sales permit suspension hearings for sales to a minor: 7/Eleven, 63 Mammoth Rd., violation on 8/19/26, $1,000 fine, paid
Tobacco product sales permit suspension hearings for sales to a minor: Lowell Quick Stop Corp., 189 E. Merrimack St., violation on 03/27/26, $1,000 fine, paid
Tobacco Control Monthly Report, submitted by Cesar Pungirum, Program Director
Development Services Monthly Reports, submitted by Matthew Sheehan, Sr., Sanitary Code Inspector
PrideStar EMS, Inc. Reports and Notifications, submitted by Jon Kelley
Departmental and divisional reports: Public Health Division, School Health Division, and Substance Abuse Division monthly report
location: Mayor's Reception Room, 375 Merrimack St., 2nd floor, Lowell, MA 01852
